name: Attempt to Disable Windows Defender via Registry
description: Detects attempts to disable Windows Defender's real-time protection or other key features by modifying its registry keys. This is a strong indicator of defense evasion.

action.description: A process attempted to set a value in a Windows Defender policy registry key, potentially to disable security features.

operational_usage: This is a critical alert. The system's primary defenses are under attack. Immediately isolate the host and investigate the offending process. Common values set are 'DisableAntiSpyware' or 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring'.
false_positive: Should be extremely rare. Only legitimate system management tools like SCCM, Intune, or Group Policy itself should be modifying these keys. Any modification by a user-land process is highly suspicious.
